understanding: Build wishbone_slave_interface monitor sampling RTL pins wb_adr_i wb_dat_i wb_dat_o wb_we_i wb_stb_i wb_cyc_i wb_ack_o wb_sel_i on observed CLK edges from fixed-period clock, reconstructing completed read and write transactions on WB_ACK_O assertion for analysis port, flushing in-flight on wb_rst_i, with X or Z and known-after-reset checks and ACK-sampled register and DLAB coverage for 8-bit addresses 0-6.
preconditions: Clock active with fixed period P_fixed started before reset and held fixed through traffic with monitor sampling on observed CLK edges
Reset asserted via wb_rst_i before configuration and observed by monitor for flush with symbolic active level pending polarity answer
Monitor bound to wishbone_slave_interface RTL pins wb_clk_i wb_rst_i wb_adr_i wb_dat_i wb_dat_o wb_we_i wb_stb_i wb_cyc_i wb_ack_o wb_sel_i in 8-bit build
Register address space 0 to 6 with DLAB aliasing at 0 to 1 defined for reconstruction and coverage
stimulus_steps: SAMPLE wb_adr_i wb_dat_i wb_dat_o wb_we_i wb_stb_i wb_cyc_i wb_ack_o wb_sel_i on each observed CLK edge into current sample
IF reset asserted THEN flush in-flight latched request and discard partial transaction and WAIT for reset deassertion before resuming reconstruction
IF WB_ACK_O asserted THEN latch address control and data from current sample and reconstruct one completed read or write transaction by WE value and EMIT to analysis port
FOR each emitted transaction CONTINUE sampling without driving DUT inputs and without inserting DUT timing delays
check_steps: IF any sampled WB_ADDR_I or WB_SEL_I or WB_DAT_I or WB_DAT_O or WB_WE_I or WB_STB_I or WB_CYC_I or WB_ACK_O or CLK or WB_RST_I equals X or Z THEN report uvm_error immediately
AFTER reset deassertion CHECK DUT outputs wb_dat_o and wb_ack_o reach known non-X or Z values before first reconstruction
coverage_steps: SAMPLE cg_wb_reg_access on WB_ACK_O assertion observed on CLK edges: cp_wb_addr addr_0 to addr_6 with illegal addr_7 and cp_wb_dir read_WE0 write_WE1 and cp_wb_data_class zero min mid_low mid_high max

SAMPLE cg_cross_addr_dlab on WB_ACK_O completion observed on CLK edges: cross address with DLAB covering addr0_dlab0_RBR_THR addr0_dlab1_DLL_SB addr1_dlab0_IER addr1_dlab1_DLM_SB addr2_to_6 variants with illegal addr_7_any_dlab
completion: Monitor runs through reset and traffic until test end with in-flight flushed on reset and only completed ACK transactions emitted
Terminate on traffic done or TEST_TIMEOUT_CYCLES operational limit; timeout is testbench limit not DUT timing

facts.statement: Integration targets 8-bit data bus build for compatibility reason.
facts.quote: It has an 8-bit data bus for compatibility reason.

facts.statement: Receiver Buffer at address 0 width 8 access R is Receiver FIFO output.
facts.quote: Receiver Buffer 0 8 R Receiver FIFO output

facts.statement: Transmitter Holding at address 0 width 8 access W is Transmit FIFO input.
Interrupt Enable at address 1 width 8 access RW enables masks interrupts.
Interrupt Identification at address 2 width 8 access R gets interrupt information.
facts.quote: Interrupt Identification 2 8 R Get interrupt information

facts.statement: FIFO Control at address 2 width 8 access W controls FIFO options.
facts.quote: FIFO Control 2 8 W Control FIFO options

facts.statement: Line Control Register at address 3 width 8 access RW controls connection.
facts.quote: Line Control Register 3 8 RW Control connection

facts.statement: Modem Control at address 4 width 8 access W controls modem.
Line Status at address 5 width 8 access R provides status information.
Modem Status at address 6 width 8 access R provides modem status.
Divisor Latch registers are accessed when DLAB bit 7 of Line Control Register is set.
facts.quote: The registers can be accessed when the 7th (DLAB) bit of the Line Control Register is set

facts.statement: When DLAB is set the normal registers at addresses 0-1 cannot be accessed.
Divisor Latch LSB at address 0 width 8 access RW holds LSB of divisor.
facts.quote: Divisor Latch Byte 1 (LSB) 0 8 RW The LSB of the divisor

facts.statement: Divisor Latch MSB at address 1 width 8 access RW holds MSB of divisor.
facts.quote: Divisor Latch Byte 2 1 8 RW The MSB of the divisor
